title: Birthday treat
description: Give clients a birthday treat such as a free add-on service. Loyalty reward WhatsApp template for beauty studios. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Send a few days before the birthday so they can book. Keep the expiry visible.

body.text: Happy birthday, {{first_name}}! Treat yourself with a complimentary {{reward}} on any service at {{studio}} until {{date}}. Thank you, and reply here if you need anything.
